text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today is the day the Tenno Sho (Spring) takes place.
I head over to watch the race together with Mejiro Dober.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, no.
It's nothing... Nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since the Fan Appreciation Festival,
she seems lost in thought."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hope watching Mejiro Bright's race today
helps lift their spirits, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...We're cutting it pretty close on time,
and Bright... still isn't here."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she's all right? She's pretty laid-back...
Could she be having trouble getting ready—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, clack, click, clack—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, well. Bright—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't bring myself to say anything more.
No matter what—I just couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Bright.
We just couldn't see it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All I could see... was the race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bright's in the lead, Bright's in the lead!
Bright takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Bright, it's Bright!!
Spring has arrived for the Mejiro family!!
Bright!! It's Mejiro Bright!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Bright! Bright! Bright!
Bright! Bright! Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...At last, it is complete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My name is Mejiro Bright.
Here at Yodo, the most dazzling, supreme radiance—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A new shield for the noble Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The arrival of a new season...
Blooms proudly in the new era of Mejiro—it is I!
Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ………………Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright... incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dober, and even Trainer!
You came all the way here to see me~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright, congratulations...!
Amazing... That was a truly amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The Spring Shield... To bring glory to Mejiro, following in McQueen's footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible!
With this, surely a "new glory" will—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yay~! With this—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Finally, we can begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After pushing through a Classic year full of narrow defeats,
I have finally welcomed this spring~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have finally achieved one accomplishment,
worthy of the Mejiro predecessors before me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It begins from here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady McQueen, and Ryan-onesama too.
Surpassing every brilliant light the Mejiro family has built until now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us go and seize our "new glory"
together, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh, Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible... Even though she grabbed a glory to be proud of,
she's already looking toward what's next...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Bright... The aura around her has changed.
It's strong, dignified, almost—yes,
almost like Air Groove-senpai...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Amazing.
How can I be more like Bright—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober.
What you desire, the future you strive for, that glory...
You will never reach it as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Those belong to none other than—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because if I'm not "Mejiro Dober,"
it's something I'll never be able to attain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wait, since when did I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Since when did you start trying to become "someone else"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Since when... did you start thinking that simply seizing the same glory as "someone else" was enough—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...On the way back from Kyoto Racecourse,
Mejiro Dober hadn't said a single word—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only after reaching the trainer's office
did those tightly shut lips finally open.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I finally get it now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What you were trying to say after the Osaka Hai. What Air Groove-senpai said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What Trainer was trying to say after the Osaka Hai. What Air Groove-senpai said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Why can't I be like Senpai... like Bright, or the other Mejiro girls?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're trying to become like everyone else,"
—right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"‘Someday, the glory that Ramonu-san envisioned...
I want to carry it on, too.’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Triple Tiara,
just so I could become like Ms. Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"‘If I can follow the path you took...
catch up to where you are...
and become just like you, Senpai—’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I set my Senior Year rotation,
striving to become like Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So today, I was thinking about how I'd like to be more like Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Even though that's not how it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: McQueen, Ryan... Bright, Air Groove-senpai, everyone—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
By my own power, on my own path, in my own way!
Because I'm resolved to make myself shine!
...She's strong, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just... lacked confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't have the resolve to shine on my own!
That's why... I just chased after everyone, hoping to bask in their light—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... it's no good.
I won't be able to seize a "new glory for Mejiro" like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm... still so weak...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's fine!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for always telling me that.
I get it. I know how you feel."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for always telling me that.
I get it. Trainer, I know how you feel."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why... I want to face it now.
I have to face it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To what I've always lost to. To my own slyness—my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, you'll still
believe in me, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, Trainer,
you'll still believe in me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know... that I can overcome
even my own weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You think of me as... that strong of an Umamusume,
don't you...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I thought you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —I'm running in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But it's not because I'm chasing after Air Groove-senpai.
It's not because I want to be like someone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To conquer my weak self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To become the truly strong me... I'll run.
